review.contract_claim: component-scoped computation and admission ledger only

provenance.upstream_scope: FAEST_256F non-EM commitment primitives only; no upstream generic direct-mask API claim
provenance.candidate_scope: new synthetic direct-mask degree-three contract; no production, Queue, or activation integration

ownership.schema_authority: this manifest is the sole machine-readable contract source

transcript.statement_binding: full canonical public statement x including context,U,T,C,relation identifier, and admitted generic parameters

wire_contract.frame_formula: statement_bytes + header_bytes + nu_bytes + nonce_count * nonce_bytes + m1_bytes + m2_bytes + m3_bytes + m4_bytes
wire_contract.nonce_sampling: WITH_REPLACEMENT_MODELLED; fresh per final candidate required

retry_abort.opening_node_count: union of selected leaf heap positions and all ancestors through root

privacy.formula: epsilon_priv <= min(1, epsilon_coins + epsilon_AR + epsilon_bitMH + epsilon_source + Adv_SHAKE_priv)
privacy.R_retry_semantics: R_retry counts every final FS3 candidate, including the first, successful, discarded, and pre-abort candidates
privacy.source_reproof_rule: a fresh proof invocation increments A; a fresh BAVC commitment instance increments M; an unchanged source assertion does not increment S; an exact byte-identical retransmission itself increments none of A, M, or S, but any cryptographic operation it triggers is charged separately, including V when it is verified
privacy.q1_aes256_definition: alpha_s(T*,Q*) is the maximum quantum AES-256 PRP distinguishing advantage for time at most T*, at most s DISTINCT CLASSICAL input blocks to one hidden independent random-key challenge oracle, and at most Q* queries to an independent public QRO; public AES computation and quantum computation are allowed, but superposition access to the hidden-key AES oracle is not allowed
privacy.block_count_semantics: derived AES block counts are source-counted bounds, not measured quantum work

full_history.T_star_formula: T* = T_adversary + C_commit*A + C_reconstruct*V + C_source*S + C_circuit + C_VH_ZK + C_transpose_pack + C_opening*R_retry + C_SHAKE(q_hist) + C_overlay(P,L_FS)

acceptance_reservations.scope: operational reservation ledger; not a QROM or theorem-event multiplier

proof_attempts.increment: after a durable nonrefundable reservation and before any commitment/challenge operation
proof_attempts.rollback: never decrement after durable reservation; failed, crashed, cleaned-up, abandoned, or restarted attempts remain counted
proof_attempts.recovery: reconcile the opaque durable reservation before retry or reissue; never resume a consumed partial proof or handoff

verification_invocations.increment: after a durable nonrefundable reservation and before a verifier invocation enters this proof backend; verifying retransmitted bytes still increments V
verification_invocations.rollback: never decrement after durable reservation; unknown or failed outcomes remain charged
verification_invocations.recovery: reconcile the opaque durable invocation record before accepting a retry; never replay retained private material

fs3_candidates.increment: after a durable nonrefundable reservation and before every final FS3 candidate call, including the first, successful, discarded, and pre-abort candidates
fs3_candidates.rollback: never decrement; exhaustion, crash, cleanup failure, or unknown outcome is fail-closed and remains charged
fs3_candidates.recovery: reconcile the opaque durable candidate sequence; never resume a consumed partial proof or handoff

source_u_parameter_issuances.increment: once for every independently sampled nonzero U parameter, including the initial issuance and each additional independent reissue
source_u_parameter_issuances.rollback: never decrement after publication/use; an unknown outcome remains charged
source_u_parameter_issuances.recovery: reconcile only the opaque issuance identity before reuse or reissue

source_commitments.increment: once per distinct fresh source root/pad commitment; an unchanged source assertion does not increment S, and an exact byte-identical retransmission itself increments none of A, M, or S
source_commitments.rollback: never decrement after durable creation; crash, cleanup failure, or unknown outcome remains charged
source_commitments.recovery: reconcile only the opaque source-commitment issuance identity before retry; never retain or replay roots, pads, or bytes

commitment_instances.increment: once per fresh protocol/BAVC commitment instance entering the privacy-hiding ledger; M is bounded by A
commitment_instances.rollback: never decrement after durable creation; crash, cleanup failure, abandoned handoff, or unknown outcome remains charged
commitment_instances.recovery: reconcile only the opaque commitment-instance identity; never resume a consumed partial proof or replay retained private material

exact_retransmits.increment: once per byte-identical retransmission only when it causes no fresh commitment, proving, or verification; verification of retransmitted bytes still increments V
exact_retransmits.rollback: audit correction only; it never refunds a consumed reservation or security counter
exact_retransmits.recovery: reconcile opaque retransmission metadata only; never persist or replay source, commitment, proof, or private bytes

bounds.R_retry: includes the first final FS3 candidate

counter_ledger.Q_definition: adversary coherent QRO queries; security-model parameter, not an application counter
counter_ledger.storage_requirement: persist opaque issuance identities and counts only; never source roots, pads, x, commitment bytes, proof bytes, or stable exact-byte hashes
counter_ledger.atomicity_requirement: durable nonrefundable reservation commits before the relevant cryptographic/challenge operation (or as a bounded up-front reservation); the outcome is recorded separately; reservation, outcome, and retry ledger fail closed if their journal is incomplete
counter_ledger.no_refund_requirement: rollback, crash, cleanup failure, abandoned or restarted handoff, and unknown outcome never refund a consumed reservation or counter
counter_ledger.recovery_requirement: recovery never resumes a consumed partial proof or handoff and never replays retained private material
